name: Oppenheimer Holdings Inc.
summary: Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. operates as a middle-market investment bank and full-service broker-dealer. It provides brokerage services covering corporate equity and debt securities, money market instruments, exchange-traded options, municipal bonds, mutual funds, exchange-traded funds, certain precious metals, and unit investment trusts; financial and wealth planning services; and margin lending services.
